tools.name: check_store_ai_readiness
tools.description: Scores a public Shopify store 0-100 for AI shopping assistants from its public catalog, robots.txt, policy pages and structured data, and returns the top issues with how to fix them. Read-only. Results are cached for 30 minutes; rate limited per client.

tools.name: explain_issue
tools.description: Returns what an issue id from check_store_ai_readiness means and how to fix it (e.g. altText, gtin, description, crawlers, jsonld, policy:refund-policy).

tools.name: get_surfaced_plans
tools.description: Lists the Surfaced Shopify app plans (Free, Pro, Growth) and the install link, for merchants who want every product scanned and safe fixes applied with undo.
